transient: Temporary read timeout/connection interruption or retryable local I/O (injected in tests; normal implementation reads a local fixture).
permanent: Invalid number or missing issue: change number using the available issue list.
Permission denied or missing/malformed fixture: maintainer must restore the resource; unchanged calls do not help.

transient: Temporary index/disk read interruption, connection timeout or retryable local I/O (no network rate limiter exists in the local stub).
permanent: Blank/overlong query, malformed path_glob, invalid format or out-of-range max_results: change the named field.
Missing/corrupt index or unreadable repository: maintainer repair is required; a valid zero-match search is not an error.

transient: Temporary read timeout, connection interruption or retryable local I/O.
permanent: Missing, wrong-case, binary, excluded or outside-repository file: choose a valid exact UTF-8 path.
Permission denied or file removed during reading: restore permission/resource or search again.

transient: Only an explicit adapter signal proving the request was not dispatched; may carry retry_after.
permanent: Invalid number or empty/overlong/unresolved body: fix arguments.
Missing issue: select an existing number; permission/resource failures need maintainer repair.
ambiguous: TrackerTimeout after dispatch, which may mean before or after commit; never infer commit status from exception text.
Unqualified timeout/connection drop or transient signal without before_dispatch proof: do not retry blind.

transient: Only an explicit adapter signal proving the request was not dispatched; may carry retry_after.
permanent: Invalid number, nonmatching branch, empty/overlong title or body: fix arguments.
Missing issue: select an existing number; permission/resource failures need maintainer repair.
ambiguous: TrackerTimeout after dispatch, which may mean before or after commit; never infer commit status from exception text.
Unqualified timeout/connection drop or transient signal without before_dispatch proof: do not retry blind.
